newsitem.title: POLAND: Rains continue overnight as Poland on flood alert.
newsitem.headline: Rains continue overnight as Poland on flood alert.

text.p: Steady rains continued overnight in the west and south of Poland and forecasts showed that more rain at the weekend could cause a repeat of disastrous floods, the central crisis committee's spokesman said on Saturday.
"The situation isn't good, rain is falling intensively in Silesia, the rivers are rising, and probably the flood will be repeated," spokesman Krzysztof Pomes said.
Pomes said eight provinces were on flood alert in the south of the country although in some places showers were less intensive and rivers rising slower than had been anticipated. @
"It started raining yesterday and should rain rather intensively today based on the information we have," he said. More details were expected in the afternoon following a crisis committee meeting.
Pomes said that although the rain was lighter than downpours two weeks ago which unleashed the floods, the soaked ground and swollen rivers were less able to absorb the excess.
